data_fields.name: reusable
data_fields.donor_constant: flag 0x80 (TrgF_REUSABLE) per trigger; default one-shot (flag 0x40 set after firing)

data_fields.name: gate_condition
data_fields.donor_constant: index of the enclosing IF condition; top level = CONDITION_ALWAYS (equals 512)

data_fields.name: turn_step
data_fields.donor_constant: one script step per game turn while the update block is not paused (play_gameturn++ at 534)

data_fields.name: outcome_latch
data_fields.donor_constant: victory_state == VicS_Undecided required before a win or lose applies

best_idea: A quest step is a condition with a latch and an edge, nested under its parent step, and its reward is a trigger that fires once and is evaluated in a fixed per-turn order.
decision_why: Keep the nested gate and the one-shot trigger; route every reward through one server ledger function, because KeeperFX has two effect dispatchers (script_process_value for values, process_party for party triggers), which breaks the one-ledger ruling.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a nested step does not complete on the turn its parent first completes, and that its reward is granted exactly once across 1000 turns and a reconnect.
